semantic_contract.operation: For FP16 Q[8,D], K/V state[2,capacity,D], append the current FP16 K/V token, select the logical SWA tail or full prefix, map query head h to KV head floor(h/4), compute FP16 QK with FP32 accumulation and scale 1.0, apply the logical mask, run numerically stable FP32 softmax, round probabilities to FP16, compute FP16 probability x FP16 V with FP32 accumulation, and round contiguous output[8,D] to FP16.
semantic_contract.gqa_mapping: query heads 0..3 use KV head 0; query heads 4..7 use KV head 1
semantic_contract.source_tensor_mutation: Only the designated cache slot for the appended current token may change; Q and all other logical K/V elements remain byte-identical.

sliding.physical_layout: head-major FP16 ring [2,1024,256] for both K and V
sliding.active_view: the newest 512 logical tokens after append, oldest-to-newest, including wrap
sliding.timed_work: append, ring-index update, active-tail gather, QK transpose pack, V pack, and padding are inside the timed boundary

full.physical_layout: head-major FP16 prefix [2,7360,512] for both K and V
full.active_view: positions 0..L-1 after appending the current token
full.timed_work: append, prefix view, QK transpose pack, V pack, and padding are inside the timed boundary

kv_state_contract.carrier_limit: The layouts are explicit synthetic state carriers. They preserve GQA, window, prefix, append, and wrap semantics but are not claimed byte-identical to RKLLM's private cache.

qk_per_kv_head.padding: K columns beyond L are zero in the packed matrix and their FP32 scores are overwritten with -infinity before softmax

pv_per_kv_head.padding: FP16 probabilities and V rows beyond L are zero

rknpu_contract.context_lifetime: Create all frozen shape/type contexts and allocate maximum buffers before timing; reuse them for every repetition. Context creation and allocation are excluded, while per-step packing, set_io, run, and output consumption are included.
rknpu_contract.capability_gate: Inside the sole formal segment and before any timing, every frozen QK/PV context must create, set core0, set I/O, run, and destroy cleanly on a correctness corpus. A failure invalidates the segment; no per-head, CPU-only, dtype, core-mask, or shape fallback is accepted.

cpu_scalar_sequence.contract: Same KV state, packing, mask, stable FP32 softmax, FP16 probability carrier, output conversion, and final layout as the hybrid path; scalar FP32 accumulation with vectorization disabled for QK/PV.

cpu_neon_sequence.role: timed complete-sequence explicit A76 NEON baseline
cpu_neon_sequence.contract: Same complete sequence with FP16 loads/conversion and FP32 NEON FMA for QK/PV; softmax remains the common scalar FP32 implementation.

hybrid_rknpu_sequence.placement: CPU orchestration and softmax pinned to CPU7; grouped QK/PV on RKNPU core0
hybrid_rknpu_sequence.contract: Two grouped QK plus two grouped PV matmul runs per attention step, without materialized KV repetition.

implementations.common_timed_boundary: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW immediately before KV append through final contiguous FP16 [8,D] output; excludes corpus generation, allocation, RKNN context creation, and result serialization.

aggregation.family_metric: invocation-weighted median latency within the frozen family cases
aggregation.model_forward_equivalent: 42 * all_attention_metric / 1000, reported in ms as an isolated population counterfactual

formal_correctness_protocol.reference: Untimed long-double-or-FP64 host implementation of the exact frozen FP16-storage/FP32-softmax/probability-round/output-round contract, with deterministic reduction order documented in the result.
state_microcases: GQA mapping proves heads 0..3 consume KV0 and heads 4..7 consume KV1
SWA ring wrap preserves the newest 512 tokens in chronological order at logical positions 1023 and 1024
full prefix append exposes exactly L tokens at L=807 and L=7359
QK padded positions receive negative infinity before softmax
PV padded probabilities and V rows are zero
FP32 pre-round softmax row sums differ from 1 by at most 2e-6 and FP16 carrier row sums differ by at most 0.01
Q and all non-appended cache elements are byte-identical before and after each trial
all outputs are finite, contiguous, FP16, and shaped [8,D]
formal_correctness_protocol.failure_rule: Any capability, state, shape, dtype, finiteness, row-sum, mutation, or elementwise failure stops before timing and closes the sole segment invalid. Do not tune against the failed corpus or rerun.

measurement_protocol.governor_restore: Record original policy6 and NPU governors and restore both on every exit path.
measurement_protocol.interleave: Rotate the six permutations of the three implementations by measurement block; no implementation may be measured in a separate thermal epoch.
measurement_protocol.timer: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW around the common complete-sequence boundary

tier_b.policy: One bundled perf-stat block per implementation and case inside the same formal segment. CPU counters describe host participation; they are not NPU operation or byte counters.

validity_gates: formal correctness and capability gates pass before timing
all three implementations have the frozen count and elapsed-time minima in all 13 cases
policy6 remains at recorded max frequency during timed windows
NPU governor and frequency remain at the frozen performance state during timed windows
rknpu load is numeric and core1/core2 remain zero for the core0 candidate
no thermal zone reaches its recorded trip point
all required perf events are numeric
runner, telemetry, and controller exit zero

allowed_before_source_lock: write the three complete-sequence implementations and formal runner
compile/link/disassembly inspection on the board without executing the benchmark binary
host-only deterministic unit checks that do not use RKNPU, formal timing, or the board
implementation_and_lock_policy.source_lock: Hash the preregistration and all three future files after compile/disassembly-only review and before the first benchmark-binary execution.
implementation_and_lock_policy.post_lock_rule: The first benchmark-binary execution is the sole formal segment. No source edit, retry, same-day retest, or replacement segment is authorized afterward.

execution_order: Independently verify this preregistration while implementation files and board execution are absent.
Implement the frozen complete sequence; perform only compile/link/disassembly review and then source-lock.
Run the sole formal segment: capability and correctness gates first, then timing, Tier-B, telemetry, restore, and receipt.
If valid, report family and population-weighted isolated results with the frozen claim limits; otherwise close with retained failure evidence.
claim_limits: No result may be called an RKLLM attention component time or subtracted from OPE4 TPOT.
FP16 board results must not be merged with BF16 RTX4060 K3 performance.
The hybrid path is a synthetic host-orchestrated carrier, not a deployable RKLLM patch.
No prefill, multi-core NPU, quality, token-equivalence, energy, or cost claim is authorized.
The 42-call forward equivalent is a census-weighted counterfactual, not an observed model-forward timer.
Only one formal segment is authorized; replication remains waived and unsatisfied.
